Contributor: aceman444 Discussion Comment No.: 4 Comment: I agree with zsolt, border control points still exist, controls are done sporadically, or can be permanent for some period, or for some types of transports (e.g. due to cattle disease). It is correct to map the points where the control can be performed. Being in EU or Schengen does not mean there are never any controls. What concerns me more is that zsolt moves the country border (in river Danube) without any real source (aerial imagery is useless for this). I will revert those changes. Date: 2026-10-19T09:40:44+02:00

Contributor: itineris Discussion Comment No.: 2 Comment: I moved the point on the bridge towards Hungary, according to the map of Magyar Közút (Hungarian Road Agency), available for OSM editors.
